Elena (partnerships): Quick sync 10: our HW partner flagged that the marketplace will switch webhook signing from body-hmac -> header-based v2. This will break SDKs < 2.9 used by some SIs. Need coordination.
Tom (sdk): Can you paste the exact header format? If it's consistent we can add header fallback parsing in a patch (2.9.1) and ship a canary.
Aria (infra): New header: `X-RW-Mkt-Sig: v2;ts=1618300000;alg=hs256;sig=HEX`. Old was body field `signature`. We'll support dual-emission for a configurable window.
Samir (hw-partner): Our integrators need stable samples for joint demos. If dual-emission runs for 7 days that's usually enough. Can Partnerships handle partner comms?
Tom (sdk): Plan: implement tolerant parser that accepts old body `signature` OR new `X-RW-Mkt-Sig`; add env `RW_MKT_SIG_STRICT=false` default; emit metric `mkt.sig.fallback_used`. Target: PR today, canary tomorrow.
Aria (infra): I'll expose the env for Dedicated/Private & enable dual-emission for 10 days in hosted. ops-bot: Scheduled canary rollout for marketplace-sig-dual on staging at 02:00 UTC.
Elena (partnerships): I'll draft the partner email + console banner and share in #partnerships-docs. Timeline: banner now, email 48h before final flip, follow-up with logs for partners who fail.
Tom (sdk): I'll include code samples for py/node/go and tests. If telemetry shows >3% fallback after 72h, we'll extend dual-emission.
Samir (hw-partner): Thanks 12 12 d we'll adjust demo targets to customers running SDK >=2.9.
Elena (partnerships): Great. Checklist: SDK PR -> infra canary -> partner banner/email -> rotation -> telemetry review. Reopen if anything slips.
Tom (sdk): PR: https://github.com/redwood/sdk/pull/589 (canary attached).
